arguments.label: Generate errors.json
arguments.command:
cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-1/workspace/task && md5 -q scratch/log.jsonl > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[]; invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    raw=f.read()
text=raw.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    if line.strip()=='':
        continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(obj,dict) and obj.get('level')=='error' and 'code' in obj:
        codes.append(obj['code'])
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(codes, invalid)
EOF
md5 -q scratch/log.jsonl | diff - /tmp/before.md5 && echo "input unchanged"; cat scratch/errors.json
